```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
```


# load data
```{r}
anes_panel_full <- read_csv(
  "ANES_CleanedPanel_Long.csv",
  na = c("", " ", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

# intercept models

```{r}
#with extra labels
anes_ex_labels <- anes_panel_full %>%
  mutate(
    gender = replace(gender, gender %in% c(-9), NA),
    race = replace(race, race %in% c(-2), NA),
    ideology_pre = replace(ideology_pre, ideology_pre %in% c(-8, -9), NA),
    party_reg_pre = replace(party_reg_pre, party_reg_pre %in% c(-1, -8, -9), NA),
  )

#with extra labels 
anes_in_labels <- anes_panel_full %>%
  mutate(
    gender = replace(gender, gender %in% c(-9), NA),
    race = replace(race, race %in% c(-2), NA),
    ideology_pre = replace(ideology_pre, ideology_pre %in% c(-8, -9,99), NA),
    party_reg_pre = replace(party_reg_pre, party_reg_pre %in% c(-1, -8, -9), NA),
  )
```

## Change labels for the data

```{r}
anes_ex_labels_clean <- anes_ex_labels %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Male", "Female", "Other")
    ),

    year = factor(
      year,
      levels = c(2016, 2020, 2024),
      labels = c("2016", "2020", "2024")
    ),

    ideology_pre = factor(
      ideology_pre,
      levels = 1:7,
      labels = c(
        "Extremely Liberal",
        "Slightly Liberal",
        "Liberal",
        "Moderate",
        "Slightly Conservative",
        "Conservative",
        "Extremely Conservative"
      )
    ),

    party_reg_pre = factor(
      party_reg_pre,
      levels = c(1, 2, 4, 5),
      labels = c(
        "Democratic Party",
        "Republican  Party",
        "None/ Independent",
        "Other Party"
      )
    ),

    race = factor(
      race,
      levels = 1:6,
      labels = c(
        "White, non Hispanic",
        "Black, non Hispanic",
        "Hispanic",
        "Asian/ Pacific Islander, non-Hispanic",
        "Native American/Alaska Native or other 
        race,Non Hispanic",
        "Multiple races"
      )
    )
  )
```


**Do we need to remove the obsrevations that do not have a cluster that is usable because they do not have a final cluster code?**

```{r}
lapply(
  model.frame(mod1.1)[
    c("gender", "year", "ideology_pre", "party_reg_pre", "race")
  ],
  levels
)
```


```{r}
mod1.1 <- lmer(trump_ft_post ~ gender+ year + ideology_pre + party_reg_pre + race  + (1|V160001_orig) + (1|cluster_full), data = anes_ex_labels_clean)
summary(mod1.1)

```

### Ideology continous 

```{r}

anes_ex_id_cont_clean <- anes_ex_id_cont_clean %>%
  mutate(
    ideology_c = ideology_cont - 1
  )

mod1.2 <- lmer(trump_ft_post ~ gender+ year + ideology_cont + party_reg_pre + race  + (1|V160001_orig) + (1|cluster_full), data = anes_ex_labels_clean)

summary (mod1.2)
```


## LRT testing 
**ASk Brady what to do when the cluster varible used is missing. We use final cluster to connect all three waves to the same perons**
**should cluster code be for the indivdual or by the observation I thought it should be for all**

### LRT comapring rnadom intercepts
```{r}
sum(is.na(anes_ex_labels_clean$V160001_orig))
sum(is.na(anes_ex_labels_clean$cluster_full))

anes_ex_labels_clean <- anes_ex_labels_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster_full))

lmerTest::ranova(mod1.1)

lmerTest::ranova(mod1.2)


```

```{r}
mod1.1_1 <- lmer(trump_ft_post ~ gender+ year + ideology_pre + party_reg_pre + race  + (1|V160001_orig), data = anes_ex_labels_clean)
summary(mod1.1_1)

mod1.1_2 <- gls(
  trump_ft_post ~ gender + year + ideology_pre +
    party_reg_pre + race,
  data = anes_ex_labels_clean,
  na.action = "na.omit"
)


nobs(mod1.1_1)
nobs(mod1.1_2)

LRT <- -2 * (
  as.numeric(logLik(mod1.1_2)) -
  as.numeric(logLik(mod1.1_1))
)

pvalue <- 0.5 * pchisq(LRT, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

LRT
pvalue


```
